releaseScope: Avoid public ORS 100km alternative-route cap: request up to 3 alternatives only for <55km direct, not for long trips or reroutes
When a short optional alternative request times out or ORS rejects it, retry a plain HGV baseline once within fixed 14.5s server/20s client budget
For highway-ON direct >=70km, omit ferry-avoidance dynamic weighting only while demanding provider waytype full coverage and rejecting ferry (9) or missing classification
For medium-distance ORS 2004 cap, retry once without expensive ferry avoid, still requiring complete non-ferry waytype
Up to 12s basic HGV provider response on long trips; skip optional IC probes if remaining budget <3s or after baseline retry
Broaden high-speed target from 55%/max80km to 85% route distance; allow more highway among near-fast candidates while preserving global 8min/10km bounds
Overpass junction cap increases from 80 to 200 results, with the same one request and no more than two optional HGV IC probes
Add privacy-safe baseline retry, mode and candidate counts to copyable highway diagnostics
Never replace driving-hgv and registered 2t truck limits with passenger-car/straight-line fallback; preserve 30/min guard, AN15 pause and DB/schema 4
